idea: COCO train-val near-duplicate audit
problem: Duplicate/near-duplicate images across splits may inflate detection AP
hyp: Deduplicated val set drops SOTA AP measurably and reorders leaderboard
why: Split leakage silently rewards memorization
novel: No published perceptual-hash + embedding dedup audit of COCO detection splits
min_exp: Run SSCD/pHash dedup, re-evaluate 10 public detectors on cleaned val
risk: Duplicate rate too low to matter

idea: Human ceiling on COCO crowd regions
problem: Crowd-region ambiguity caps achievable AP but ceiling is unknown
hyp: Expert re-annotation shows human-human AP near current SOTA in crowded scenes
why: Distinguishes model failure from annotation ambiguity
novel: Per-density human ceiling estimates absent from detection literature
min_exp: Re-annotate 500 crowded images with 3 experts, compute inter-human AP

idea: Systematic boundary bias in Cityscapes
problem: Annotator polygons may sit consistently inside true object edges

novel: Directional (signed) boundary-error analysis of annotations, not just variance
min_exp: Compare polygons to matting-derived edges on 200 images; measure signed offset

idea: LVIS rare-class AP measures label luck
problem: Rare-category AP computed from handfuls of noisy instances
hyp: Rare AP variance across bootstrap resamples exceeds typical method gaps
why: Long-tail literature may rank methods by noise
novel: Bootstrap confidence intervals per frequency bin, applied to published checkpoints
min_exp: Bootstrap LVIS val 1000x, compute rare-AP CI for 8 models
risk: CIs may be tight, negative result only

idea: Compression-artifact shortcuts in benchmarks
problem: JPEG quality correlates with class/source, giving detectors non-semantic cues
hyp: Re-encoding val images at uniform quality shifts per-class AP
why: Reveals brittle shortcut features
novel: Compression as confound is unstudied for detection benchmarks
min_exp: Re-encode COCO val at fixed quality; measure per-class AP deltas

idea: ADE20K overlapping class definitions
problem: Classes like grass/field/plant overlap, making some errors undefined
hyp: A confusion-tolerant metric merging ambiguous pairs reorders model rankings
why: mIoU penalizes disagreement about wording, not vision
novel: Data-driven ambiguity graph from annotator disagreement, applied to scoring
min_exp: Mine cross-annotator confusions, rescore 10 models with merged classes

idea: Residual COCO errors are mostly label errors
problem: Benchmark 'saturation' may be annotation ceiling, not model ceiling
hyp: >50% of top-model false positives are actually correct detections
why: Redirects field from architecture tweaks to data repair
novel: Exhaustive human audit of a SOTA model's remaining errors
min_exp: Manually verify 1000 highest-confidence 'false positives' of a SOTA detector

idea: Geography shortcut in driving benchmarks
problem: Camera model and city are confounded with labels
hyp: A classifier predicts city from image statistics; segmenters exploit same cues
why: Cross-city generalization claims may be optical, not semantic
novel: Explicit confound quantification via sensor-fingerprint probes
min_exp: Train city classifier on low-level stats; correlate with seg errors

idea: Rater-adjusted medical seg leaderboards
problem: Inter-rater variance exceeds SOTA gaps on many medical benchmarks
hyp: Ranking against multi-rater consensus differs from single-rater ground truth
why: Clinical claims rest on possibly meaningless deltas
novel: Leaderboard re-scored with rater-noise-aware statistical model
min_exp: Use existing multi-rater subsets (e.g., LIDC) to rescore public methods

idea: Shuffled-frame probe for video segmentation
problem: VOS benchmarks may reward temporal copy-paste, not tracking
hyp: Frame-shuffled evaluation barely degrades top methods
why: Exposes whether temporal modeling is real
novel: Order-destruction stress test as standard VOS diagnostic
min_exp: Evaluate 5 VOS models on shuffled DAVIS sequences

idea: Pretraining contamination of open-vocab detection
problem: 'Novel' classes appear in web pretraining corpora

novel: Frequency-stratified contamination analysis for detection benchmarks
min_exp: Count LVIS-rare class mentions in LAION captions; regress against AP

idea: WordNet-sibling leakage in zero-shot seg splits
problem: 'Unseen' classes are often near-synonyms of seen classes
hyp: Semantic distance to nearest seen class predicts unseen-class IoU
why: Split design determines reported generalization
novel: Leakage score for split construction, plus a distance-controlled re-split
min_exp: Compute embedding distances; re-split PASCAL-ZS3 and re-benchmark

idea: Size-stratified mIoU
problem: mIoU underweights small objects that dominate real errors
hyp: Size-stratified scoring flips rankings among current SOTA segmenters
why: Applications (driving, medical) care about small structures
novel: Standardized small/medium/large mIoU with ranking-flip analysis
min_exp: Rescore Cityscapes leaderboard checkpoints by object-size bins

idea: Decompose AP into recognition vs localization
problem: IoU-threshold-averaged AP hides where models fail
hyp: Recent AP gains are mostly localization sharpening, not recognition
why: Guides where research effort actually pays off
novel: Longitudinal decomposition across 10 years of detectors
min_exp: Apply TIDE-style decomposition to historical checkpoints, plot trend

idea: Mask AP vs boundary-F ranking flips
problem: Mask AP rewards blobby masks; boundary quality diverges
hyp: ≥20% of pairwise model rankings flip between mask AP and boundary F

novel: Systematic flip-rate quantification across model families
min_exp: Score 15 instance-seg models with both metrics; count flips

idea: Soft panoptic quality
problem: PQ's hard 0.5-IoU matching creates score discontinuities
hyp: Soft matching yields smoother, better human-aligned rankings

novel: Continuous-relaxation PQ with human preference validation
min_exp: Implement soft-PQ; correlate with human pairwise judgments on 300 images

idea: AP gains from score recalibration alone
problem: AP rewards confidence ranking, not detection quality

idea: Dataset-mIoU vs per-image mIoU disagreement
problem: Global mIoU lets models ignore rare classes and whole images

novel: Failure-tail analysis linking metric choice to worst-image performance

idea: Dice blindness to topology errors

idea: Seed-variance meta-analysis of seg SOTA claims
problem: Single-run leaderboards; seed noise vs claimed gains unknown

novel: Empirical variance atlas across architectures and datasets
min_exp: Train 5 seeds for 6 representative models; compare to published deltas

idea: Prompt sensitivity as hidden metric variable
problem: Open-vocab detection scores depend on prompt templates
hyp: Prompt choice shifts AP more than typical method gaps
why: Benchmarks measure prompt engineering, not vision
novel: Prompt-marginalized evaluation protocol with variance reporting
min_exp: Evaluate 5 OV detectors under 20 prompt sets; report spread

idea: Protocol-induced gains audit
problem: Resize/crop/TTA evaluation details differ silently across papers

novel: Re-evaluation of public checkpoints under one frozen protocol
min_exp: Re-run 20 seg checkpoints with standardized inference; diff vs papers

idea: Low-confidence spam exploitation of AP
problem: AP never penalizes extra low-score predictions

min_exp: Add ranked spam boxes to 5 detectors; plot AP inflation

idea: Noise floor of boundary metrics
problem: Boundary IoU depends on annotation raster resolution and polygon density

idea: Pretraining-scale reversal for dense tasks
problem: Assumption: more pretraining data always helps segmentation
hyp: Beyond a scale, classification-oriented pretraining hurts boundary precision

novel: Controlled scaling curve measured on boundary metrics, not just mIoU

idea: Random init matches ImageNet pretraining with modern recipes
problem: 'Pretraining is necessary for seg' rests on old training setups
hyp: Modern augmentation and schedules close the gap at moderate data sizes
why: Updates a foundational assumption post-2019
novel: He et al. 'Rethinking' replicated with transformers and current recipes
min_exp: Train ViT-based seg from scratch vs pretrained on Cityscapes, equal compute

idea: Does multi-scale TTA help or exploit the metric?

idea: Linear probes vs heavy decoders on frozen ViTs
problem: Assumption: complex decoders are needed for segmentation

novel: Systematic decoder-capacity sweep on frozen foundation features

idea: Loss-function factorial study for segmentation
problem: Dice/CE/focal/boundary loss combos assumed important

novel: Full factorial ANOVA attributing variance to training factors
min_exp: Grid over 6 losses x 3 schedules x 3 augs on 2 datasets

idea: Copy-paste helps via data or via effective epochs?

novel: Compute-matched decoupling of augmentation content vs training length

idea: Do attention heads actually localize instances?

idea: Are self-supervised features more robust for dense tasks?

novel: Corruption-benchmark comparison at feature and fine-tuned levels
min_exp: Evaluate SSL vs supervised backbones on Cityscapes-C

idea: Non-monotonic resolution scaling for small objects
problem: Assumption: higher input resolution always helps small-object detection

idea: Randomize DETR queries at inference

idea: Is sim-to-real gap texture or geometry?

idea: CLIP text embeddings vs learned prototypes

idea: Registry of failed segmentation architectures

idea: Test-time adaptation fails on realistic streams

idea: Distillation gains vanish with stronger student schedules

idea: Blind-domain protocol exposes DG overfitting

idea: Few-shot seg vs honestly-tuned fine-tuning

idea: Detector attention explanations fail sanity checks
